🗓 Fix / Shift Daily Sale Dates

Move daily sale entries from one date to another across the whole team — for correcting dates that were recorded a day early. Only the sale amount moves; timing and field-activity entries stay where they are, and each month's running total is preserved. 🏆 Foreign Tour Policy 2026
Policy Nos. 09-D-26 (Dealer) · 9A-D-26 (Sales Team) · 9B-D-26 (RSM) — dated 03.07.2026
Policy Period
01 Jul – 15 Aug 2026
Coupon Threshold
Rs 1,200,000
Applicable To
Fertilizer + Special Products
RSM Qualifies At
12 Coupons / Region
Dealer Qualification: A dealer earns one Foreign Tour Coupon for every Rs. 1,200,000 of Fertilizer + Special Product sales.
Sales Team Incentive (per rep, per coupon earned): Coupon 1 = Rs 24,000 · Coupon 2 = Rs 48,000 · Coupon 3 = Rs 108,000. (The policy document doesn't define a rate beyond the 3rd coupon — a 4th+ coupon is flagged for manual confirmation rather than guessed.)
RSM Qualification: An RSM qualifies when their region reaches 12 coupons total, combining every dealer under all reporting ASMs/SAMs/ZSMs in that region.
Terms: Only Fresh Cash Sales count · No PSI payable under this policy · Invoice discount is 10% on the prevailing rate · One complete coupon invoices at once · Withdrawable at any time without notice · Government taxes/levies apply.
📝 Log a Qualifying Sale
Fertilizer + Special Product cash sales aren't tracked as their own category elsewhere in the dashboard, so qualifying sales toward this specific policy are logged here — this is what coupon counts below are calculated from.
